SW1/SW2 to the inductor may run through multiple vias under the IC to an inner/bottom layer; minimise that copper area (E and H field radiation) and its parasitic capacitance to other traces/planes; BTST caps may be connected with vias on both sides.
REGN cap close to the REGN pin with a short trace, then >=2 vias from its ground to the internal ground plane.
0.1 uF small cap close to the VBUS pin; the 10 uF VBUS bulk may be placed further away; >=2 ground vias per cap.
BAT capacitors close to BAT and GND.
Via size/count sufficient for each current path.
Route BATP and TS traces away from SW1/SW2.
Values: REGN 4.7 uF 10 V; BTST1/BTST2 47 nF 10 V; BATP 100 ohm series; BAT 2x10 uF; SYS 5x10 uF + 0.1 uF closest; PMID 3x10 uF + 0.1 uF closest; SDRV 1 nF only when no ship FET.

layout_rules.rule: The input-capacitor/power-ground loop is the most critical feature: traces wide and short, loop area as small as possible.
Min 4.7 uF ceramic at VIN (rated >=Vin max, prefer 2x) plus a small-case 100 nF as close as possible to the regulator (EVM: ~0.38 mm away).
Input capacitors as close as possible to VIN and GND terminals.
VCC 1 uF close to the VCC pin with short wide traces to VCC and GND; do not load VCC (except PG pull-up).
CBOOT 100 nF >=16 V close to the device, short/wide traces to BOOT and SW.
Feedback divider (RFBT, RFBB, CFF) physically close to FB; FB and GND connections short; VOUT sense may be longer but never near SW.
Keep SW copper short and wide but minimal in area (radiated EMI).
Solid ground plane on a middle layer; GND pin to planes with vias next to the bypass caps; keep VIN/SW/GND copper on one side of the plane, sensitive routes on the other side.
Electrolytic/tantalum (20-100 uF) in parallel with input ceramics damps long input leads; no snap-back TVS on VIN.
Reference placement: CIN, CINHF, CVCC, CBOOT, L, COUT, RFBT/RFBB/CFF arrangement.
IN needs a bypass capacitor at the IN pin (4.7 uF generally sufficient); stable with >=4.7 uF IN capacitance.
ILIM resistor Kelvin-connected to the LT3045 GND pin.
SET resistor ground side Kelvin-connected to the load.
OUTS Kelvin-connected directly to the output capacitor and load; tie GND of COUT and CSET directly together (4-terminal connection, Fig. 3).
COUT >=10 uF, ESR <20 mOhm, ESL <2 nH; ~1 MHz loop bandwidth sits near a 10 uF 1206 SRF, so avoid extra ESR/ESL outside the loop.
SET is high impedance: guard ring tied to OUT on both board sides; 100 nA leakage = 0.1 % error; a 10 nF SET bypass suppresses coupled signals.
Keep GND sides of CIN and COUT reasonably close; demo-board layout recommended.
Switching-frequency current flowing near the LT3045 couples magnetically and can cost >30 dB PSRR at 1 MHz; CIN may only be omitted if the switcher output cap is >1 inch away.
A ferrite bead or ~0.5 inch PCB trace between switcher output and LT3045 input filters VHF spikes; 0.1-0.5 ohm series R or higher-ESR tantalum damps long input wiring.
Decouple VPOS with two capacitors (eval: 100 pF 0402 + 0.1 uF 0402) placed as close as possible to the VPOS pin.
Exposed pad to thermal and electrical ground; COMM to a low-impedance ground plane.
RFIN must be externally ac-coupled; nominal 250 ohm input.
FLT2/FLT3 (and FLT4) capacitors are supply-referenced (return to VPOS); FLT1 capacitor returns to ground.
VENV capacitive load must not exceed 10 pF (500 ohm || 10 pF max) for full envelope bandwidth; never dc-couple 50 ohm; EREF may take a capacitor to ground.
Low-impedance VDD connection; >=0.1 uF ceramic as close to VDD as possible.
Open-drain variants need a pull-up close to the RESET pin (TLV809E is push-pull; it drives U2 ENBL directly).
